description: How each GeoTIFF ProjCoordTransGeoKey code maps to a PROJ/EPSG method and how its parameters are read from GeoKeys, transcribed from libgeotiff GTIFFetchProjParms and GDAL GTIFGetOGISDefn. See crs/README.md for the schema and the rules.

units.angular: values of angular_keys are multiplied by the GeogAngularUnits (or GeogAngularUnitSize) factor to give degrees
units.linear: values of linear_keys are multiplied by the ProjLinearUnits (or ProjLinearUnitSize) factor to give metres
